verdict.rationale: Column is API-first, so it can be driven entirely headlessly. A fully sandboxed API that persists data like production, `/simulate/*` endpoints for incoming wires and ACH, mode-scoped API keys, idempotency keys, webhooks configurable via API, and a published OpenAPI spec together make unattended automation and CI test runs practical. missing for 10: an official CLI or SDKs (an engineer says customers use raw HTTP APIs), explicit CI/CD integration guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
